body:
The Build tab shows past builds, not just the newest release.

- A list of builds: version, date, status, and the source commit each was built from.
- Choosing a passed build shows its release: its artifacts (download, open folder), its release notes and its build log.

Done when: every build kept in the store appears in the list, and any past release's artifacts, notes and log can be reached from it.
title: history: list past builds and releases
